subject: Barplot Values as Labels in Secondary Y-axis

messages.author: e2589719bf554cfe
messages.subject: Barplot Values as Labels in Secondary Y-axis
parts:
I have a horizontally flipped barplot whose bar values I want printed
in the secondary y-axis (see crossed positions in attachment). I am
basically trying to print the values in the same position as the axis
labels, but on the right hand side of my plot. The furthest I've gone
is printing them above the bars using geom_text().

This [1] is somewhat close to what I would like to achieve.

### dataset ###

Code,Count
A,2
B,2
C,4
D,11
E,15
F,17


### R Code ###

dataset <- read.table("thedataset.dat", header=TRUE, sep=",")

ggplot(dataset, aes(x=Code, y=Count, fill=Code, width=0.75)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity") + labs(x="", y="") +
theme(legend.position="none", legend.title=element_blank(),
legend.position="bottom", axis.text.x=element_blank(),
axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.y=element_blank()) +
scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2") + geom_text(aes(x=Code, y=Count,
ymax=max(dataset$Count),
label=paste(round((Count/sum(dataset$Count)*100),0), "%"),
hjust=ifelse(sign(Count)>0, 1, 0)), position =
position_dodge(width=1)) + coord_flip()


[1] http://stackoverflow.com/q/3938126/664424

Hi,

There is a lot going on in this plot that I can't bring myself to
recreate, but for the label part how about

dataset <- read.csv(text="Code,Count
A,-2
B,2
C,4
D,11
E,15
F,17")

library(ggplot2)

dataset$labelpos <- max(dataset$Count) + diff(range(dataset$Count)/10)

ggplot(dataset, aes(x=Code, y=Count, width=0.75)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity") +
geom_rect(aes(xmin = .9:5.9,
xmax=1.1:6.1,
ymin = labelpos-1, ymax=labelpos+1),
color="black",
fill="white") +
geom_text(aes(x=Code, y=labelpos,
label=paste(round(dataset$Count/sum(dataset$Count)*100), "%")),) +
coord_flip()

?

Best,
Ista
